comparison.objective: Use tweezers to move a baked wafer from a hotplate into a single-wafer carrier, pattern side up, then lock it counterclockwise.
comparison.physical_skill: Work tweezers under a flat fragile wafer, transfer and orient it, then operate a reverse-direction twist lock.
comparison.success_condition: Wafer is in the carrier pattern-side up and the carrier is locked counterclockwise; exact damage and seating thresholds are not stated.
comparison.reason: Precision transfer and twist-lock closure differ in mechanism and outcome from impact fracture and fragment containment.
